coverage.row: Acceptance 1: manual ref держит CJS parent до позднего сообщения unref Worker; повторные ref и один unref не оставляют hold
Acceptance 2: default/raw infrastructure drain, native identity/transfer, global/builtin aliases без listener-only keepalive
Acceptance 3: own/peer close асинхронен и однократен; queued bytes и partial order сохранены; поздний ref не оживляет
Acceptance 4: managed transfer запрещён до любого detachment; обычные ArrayBuffer transfers и native identity сохранены
Acceptance 5: shared primordial переживает второй bundle и повторный install; raw kernel ports не становятся managed
Parity 1: optional manual refs, sole hold, idempotence, return values, hasRef transitions
Parity 2: global/builtin aliases и unref Worker/kernel infrastructure drain
Parity 3: own/peer close, exact queued bytes, callback counts, native identity, partial order
Parity 4: managed transfer ceiling без partial detach; native ArrayBuffer transfer
Parity 5: второй kernel bundle и однократная public installation
torn-state × repeated ref/unref/close: count/release once, closed handle не оживает
observable-order × queued send then close: data и immediate до close; без выдуманного total order
provenance-lie × ownership-losing transfer: named throw до всех detachments
sibling-drift × global/builtin и raw/private channels: тот же guest API, неизменная инфраструктура
frozen-assumption × second-bundle primordial capture: исходный constructor после public replacement
kernel.getKernelHostMessageChannel(): realm-shared primordial
globalThis.MessageChannel: реальные native local pairs, once-only wrapper
node:worker_threads.MessageChannel: alias глобального constructor
MessagePort.ref(): idempotent manual hold, undefined return, без revival после close
MessagePort.unref(): один release после повторных ref, undefined return
MessagePort.hasRef(): initial false, manual transitions, false после close
MessagePort.close(): own/peer async notification, release once, queued partial order
MessagePort.start(): native delivery queue с отслеживанием queued close
MessagePort.postMessage(): native bytes/overloads; managed transfer guard
MessagePort.onmessage setter: native delivery/start для queued tracking
structuredClone(): checked transfer dictionary, frozen options, intact rejected endpoint/companion
Worker.prototype.postMessage(): native transfers через общий managed-transfer guard
globalThis.postMessage(): native transfer entry через общий managed-transfer guard
